evidence.question: What is the dividend yield?
evidence.text: Saudi Aramco's (2222) dividend yield is 5.23% as of 2026-10-20, based on its current stock price of SAR 25.48. DBThe dividend yield calculation includes the most recent dividend payments, which have been:- SAR 0.34 per share for Q2 2026 (ex-date 2026-08-19) DB- SAR 0.34 per share for Q1 2026 (ex-date 2026-06-01) DB- SAR 0.34 per share for Q4 2025 (ex-date 2026-03-16) DB- SAR 0.33 per share for Q3 2025 (ex-date 2025-11-17) DBOver the past year, the dividend payments have been consistent, with four quarterly payments totaling approximately SAR 1.34 per share on an annualized basis.

evidence.question: ما هو عائد التوزيعات؟
evidence.text: عائد التوزيعات لأسهم أرامكو السعودية (2222) هو 5.23% اعتباراً من 2026-10-20، بناءً على آخر سعر إغلاق عند 25.48 ريال سعودي.
